To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the age of the oocyte is an important parameter in rabbit somatic cell NT.

(1) rabbit NT embryos derived from young oocytes collected at the metaphase II stage (10-12 h post-hCG) have a significantly higher blastocyst rate than those from older oocytes (14-16 h post-hCg); (2) the blastocyst rate of rabbit NT embryos derived with oocytes collected 10-12 post-hCG was significantly higher than that of embryos derived from oocyte collected 14-18 post-hCG; and (3)
rabbit oocytes collected at a relatively young stage (12 hpi) were superior to older oocytes for the development of rabbit NT embryos.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the developmental potential of rabbit NT embryos derived from young oocytes, which is a significant improvement compared to the previous reports.

the use of young oocytes in NT is beneficial to the developmental potential of rabbit cloned embryos.

the optimal age for oocyte collection for NT is 10-12 hours post hCG injection.
